clauses.quote: Upon request, Family Care and Medical Leave for up to four (4) months without pay shall be granted to an eligible unit member within any twelve- (12) month period.
clauses.subject_text: Family Care and Medical Leave for up to four (4) months without pay

clauses.quote: A health care provider's verification of a serious illness or serious health condition shall be provided by the employee at the time a request for leave is filed with the Assistant Superintendent-Human Resources.
clauses.subject_text: A health care provider's verification of a serious illness or serious health condition

clauses.quote: No Family Care and Medical Leave shall be granted if an undue hardship would be created regarding the operation of the District.
clauses.subject_text: No Family Care and Medical Leave

clauses.quote: The District shall consider alternative means to alleviate the situation.
Health benefits as provided to active employees shall be provided during the first twelve (12) weeks of such leave.
clauses.subject_text: Health benefits as provided to active employees

clauses.quote: The District shall consider granting a unit member, upon request of the unit member's medical advisor, an unpaid leave for health reasons.
The District may require a statement by the District's selected physician to the effect that such leave is necessary.
The physician's cost shall be borne by the District.

The District may grant a unit member an unpaid leave of absence of one (1) year (renewable with permission for an additional year) to pursue a District-approved program of professional development which may include, but not be limited to, additional schooling and/or training, research, participation in faculty exchange programs, or travel related to the unit member's present assignment.
